mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in > 50% of instances when UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over 3 months signals strong demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in > 50% of instances when HOUST increases over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when INDPRO YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 5% YoY signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in > 50% of instances when RSAFS YoY > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a robust labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative or unchanged in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 200k & UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS MoM > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive or unchanged in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 QoQ < -1%.
